function: Excluded (no_learning): GPT-4 is prompted in-context as a black-box search operator inside an iterative grey wolf metaheuristic; no model is trained (p. 9).
notes: Reason no_learning. p. 7: 'a LLM is employed as a black-box operator, performing two key tasks: encircling and hunting'; p. 9: 'The LLM does not perform online training or parameter updates; instead, it leverages in-context learning'; p. 10: GPT-4.0 is the 'LLM search operator'. No model is trained on channel data, and the ISAC design is solved by the Tchebycheff-decomposed GWO loop with Pareto archive (p. 7-9), an iterative algorithm.
